# Connecting integrations

<!-- Generated by `python -m scripts.connections --markdown`; do not edit by hand. -->

Every integration is configured only through environment variables (`.env` locally, a
Kubernetes Secret/ConfigMap in production). Fill in an integration's **required**
variables, restart the API, and its tools appear for the agent. Nothing else changes.

1. Copy `.env.example` to `.env` (all variables below are already listed there).
2. Set `DEMO_MODE=false` — demo mode replaces every integration with synthetic data.
3. Fill in the required variables of the systems you use; leave the rest empty.
4. Run `python -m scripts.connections` to see what is still missing, then
   `python -m scripts.connections --check` to test the live connections.

Admins can see the same status in the API at `GET /api/v1/integrations?check=true`.

## Core (Jira, GitHub, Keka, Gmail)

### Jira Cloud (`jira`)

API token from id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens; base URL https://<site>.atlassian.net.

- Required: `JIRA_BASE_URL`, `JIRA_EMAIL`, `JIRA_API_TOKEN`
- Optional: `JIRA_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`, `JIRA_STORY_POINTS_FIELD`
- API docs: https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/

### GitHub (`github`)

Fine-grained token: read PRs, contents, actions, checks (+ PR write for comments).

- Required: `GITHUB_TOKEN`
- Optional: `GITHUB_API_URL`, `GITHUB_ALLOWED_REPOS`, `GITHUB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`
- API docs: https://docs.github.com/rest

### Keka HRMS (`keka`)

Keka admin → Integrations → API access (client id/secret + API key).

- Required: `KEKA_BASE_URL`, `KEKA_CLIENT_ID`, `KEKA_CLIENT_SECRET`, `KEKA_API_KEY`
- Optional: `KEKA_TOKEN_URL`, `KEKA_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`
- API docs: https://developers.keka.com/

### Gmail (drafts) (`gmail`)

Google Cloud OAuth client; servers set the refresh token, local dev runs `python -m scripts.gmail_auth` once to create GMAIL_TOKEN_FILE.

- Required: `GMAIL_CLIENT_ID`, `GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET`, `GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN`
- Optional: `GMAIL_REDIRECT_URI`, `GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_FILE`, `GMAIL_TOKEN_FILE`, `GMAIL_ALLOWED_RECIPIENT_DOMAINS`
- API docs: https://developers.google.com/gmail/api
